title: Fixed Guided Bifold Door Kit
description: One original complete fixed folded two-leaf interior doorway kit: a freestanding square-headed frame encloses a true passage, two thick recessed-panel leaves fold toward the front around a side pivot and a central vertical hinge, while the free upper end meets a real slotted top channel with a fixed stem and captive head. Visible hinge straps join each leaf to its barrels; a single pull belongs to the free leaf. New complete assembly, not old single leaves duplicated or the freestanding three-panel education display renamed. One fixed pose only: no opening animation, continuous clearance, load, installation, accessibility or old-wall compatibility certification.
